title: epiphyllum phyllanthus subsp. guatemalense
intro: Epiphyllum phyllanthus subsp. guatemalense, commonly known as the Guatemalan Epiphyllum, is a type of cactus plant that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Epiphyllum phyllanthus subsp. guatemalense include its ability to calm the nervous system and alleviate anxiety, as well as its potential to aid in wound healing and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, terpenoids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
